steps: Update Artemis to the latest firmware: sending and receiving knob moves as MIDI CC came in an update.
Set its MIDI channel in its settings menu (on the screen) to match the channel you pick here.
Connect it by USB, or its 5-pin MIDI OUT and IN to your MIDI interface.
Turn on CC send and receive in its MIDI settings, so knob moves reach a bandmate's Artemis.
There's no command to fetch its current sound: both players load the same preset, and knob moves follow live.
